contact: Report left, right, bilateral contact independently; not called grasp success.
lift: Object center at least0.05m above immediately pre-action initial center, during VLA phase.
grasp_success: At least40 consecutive20Hz VLA-phase steps with lift>=0.05m and bilateral finger contact.
placement: Unchanged v2_open_command_and_75mm_gap_40_steps; report placement and joint grasp+placement separately.

visibility.reference: Posthoc same simulation state and camera, hide only leaf visual alpha. Evaluation-only; never returned to policy.
visibility.measure: Actual apple-like red pixels divided by reference red pixels for each actual camera. This is a red-pixel proxy, not exact visible surface fraction; reference0 means unmeasured.
visibility.raw_ratio: Retain raw; clamp to[0,1] only for bounded summary gains.
visibility.within_active: Initial frame0 versus actual post-observation frame45; auxiliary information gain threshold0.20.
visibility.between_methods: Both actual images and evaluation-only states at shared elapsed frame45=2.25simseconds; avoid comparing only active-after to baseline-initial.
visibility.sufficiency: Existing observer red>=200 pixels criterion; separate from ratio gain and manipulation success.

drop_candidates.condition_a: After50mm lift, neither finger touching, worldZ velocity<-0.15m/s, outside tray footprint.
drop_candidates.reporting: Save candidate steps and review images/videos; distinguish conservative algorithmic drop candidates from verified physical drops.

timing: Shared45simsecond/900step total budget includes observation. Report observation/manipulation simulation time and measured wall time separately; no wall-time performance claim.
skip_rate: Among enabled-reobservation trials, observation_steps==0 divided byN, separately clear/leaf. Disabled mode is not an automatic skip.
pairing: Same initial-state file/hash, seed, instruction, weights, physical settings. Both methods use live camera updates throughout manipulation.
